protocol: UNIFIED-TOKENS test (a), 2026-09-27: volume-trained provided-geometry ISLA (sg_drvol_provided_seed42/43, code_v3/recipe_v3, 435 cars, 200k interior queries, lr 5e-4) evaluated at the surface dataset's 200,000 vehicle cell centroids of the 48 validation cars (same draw and seed as the fleet scorer); query normals = -cell_normals (the distance gradient into the fluid; the surface dataset's cell normals point into the body, diagnostic 2026-09-27), query sdf = 0 (variant: 2.5e-7, the median |sdf| of the volume set's nearest-wall training points); measure-weighted relative L2 on pressure (Cp) per car, the fleet metric; surface reference p200k_dr_isla_seed42/43 (code_ref/recipe_globin, 200k cells). Pressure only: the volume model has no wall-shear output. First pass with unflipped normals kept for the record.
